Commands:            organize, list, move, clean, duplicates

  iorg move <SourceItemId> [<TargetItemId>] ((-r|--root) <dir>|(-a|--app) <dir>) [(-t|--tenant) <name>] [(-p|--pathconv) <1|2|3|4>]
  iorg clean <ItemId> ((-r|--root) <dir>|(-a|--app) <dir>) [(-t|--tenant) <name>] [-i|--image <nr>] [--force]
  iorg clean --cache ((-r|--root) <dir>|(-a|--app) <dir>) [(-t|--tenant) <name>]
Options:
-h, --help           print out all options
-v, --version        print version info
-l, --nologo         do not display the banner
-d, --debug          enable debug output
-c, --cloud          no DefaultCloudOrder providers are configured
-s, --source         no source image directory given
--source-url         HTTPS ZIP archive source
-o, --out            receipt JSON file; --receipt is an alias
--json               write machine-readable output for the selected command
--long               list only: structured inventory with --json
--all-files          list only: include unrecognized files; metadata only
--checksum           list only: sha256 with --long --json
--ignore-case        list or duplicates: match filename patterns without case distinctions
--match              duplicates only: <bytes|visual>; bytes is the default
--visual-profile     duplicates only: strict-v1; complete visuals, audio excluded
--exif               select '*' or comma-separated EXIF tags/patterns
--move               delete a single source file only after verified ingestion
